visual_identity.core_identity: Huge crude giant humanoids defined by massive heavy anatomy, broad coarse faces, oversized hands and feet, and awkward interaction with human-sized spaces.
visual_identity.silhouette: Very large broad torso, thick limbs, heavy belly or chest mass, oversized hands and feet, slightly stooped posture.
visual_identity.head_features: Broad heavy face, low brow, wide nose, large jaw, small deep-set eyes; coarse giant features without tusks.
visual_identity.body_shape: Massive thick-limbed humanoid, wider and heavier than a troll, with obvious giant scale.
visual_identity.surface: Mostly bare skin with sparse scars, folds, or restrained corpse damage depending on variant.

accuracy_checks: reads as ogre before generic brute
body is broad and heavy rather than lanky
face is coarse and broad without tusks

known_failure_modes.symptom: ogre becomes lanky with very long arms
known_failure_modes.correction: shorten relative arm length and restore broad heavy torso and thick giant limbs

known_failure_modes.symptom: ogre gains tusks, boar nose, or armored orc styling
known_failure_modes.correction: remove tusks and orc cues; restore broad coarse giant face and simple gear

known_failure_modes.symptom: anatomy becomes sharply defined heroic muscle
known_failure_modes.correction: use blunt heavy mass, thick limbs, and less anatomical definition
